summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of NF-e system completed. All 14 pytest backend tests passed (auth, company, clients, products, invoices with tax calc, emit, XML/PDF download, cancel, dashboard). Frontend Playwright E2E covered login -> save settings -> create client -> create product -> 3-step invoice wizard -> emit -> view detail with totals + downloads. Emit status 'pendente' with informative motivo about missing A1 certificate is the expected/correct behavior since no cert is uploaded.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py seed_admin uses default 'admin@example.com' fallback if ADMIN_EMAIL missing - acceptable but note.
server.py _set_cookie uses samesite='none' + secure=True which is correct for cross-site preview URL; JWT is also returned in body and used via Bearer as fallback (good).
InvoiceDetail cancel confirms via AlertDialog - good UX.
nfe_utils.assinar_xml uses sha1 which is deprecated in general but is required by SEFAZ NFe 4.00 spec - correct.
cert_password stored plaintext in Mongo - acceptable per requirement but flag for production hardening.
Consider adding pagination on clients/products/invoices list (currently .to_list(1000-2000)) - fine for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Test created TEST_ prefixed client, product, and 4 invoices during runs. Delete cleanup ran for client/product. Invoices remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover full flow. All auth/CRUD/emit/dashboard flows verified. Real SEFAZ transmission untested by design (no A1 cert). Emit currently returns status='pendente' with motivo mentioning certificate - this is intentional.
